questions.stem: A 45 years old lady underwent Roux-en-Y gastric bypass 2 years ago. She comes to the emergency with sudden onset abdominal pain and vomiting. She is afebrile. Abdomen exam shows vague diffuse tenderness. An urgent CECT abdomen is done, which shows dilated small bowel loops. Which of these is a dangerous late complication in this case?
